data.title: 千反田爱瑠 · 夏夜祭典苹果糖的娇憨浅笑
data.description: 提着金鱼袋漫步在祭典街市。爱瑠手里拿着红亮剔透的苹果糖，凑到折木嘴边递出。身后是五彩缤纷的灯笼长廊与捞金鱼摊位，人声鼎沸中，她的紫瞳里只有折木的影子，面颊在灯火掩映下泛起可爱的酡红。
data.location: 夏夜祭典红灯笼庙会街市中
data.action: 手递红亮苹果糖到嘴边，提金鱼袋浅笑，紫瞳倒映灯火
data.lighting: 百盏纸灯笼暖红光芒与摊位烟火气
data.camera: medium shot, holding apple candy, feeding, festival lanterns
data.promptProse: Eru holds a goldfish bag at her hip and offers a red candied apple to Houtarou Oreki. Her long straight black hair and violet furisode with its gold sash catch the festival light. Oreki, with short untidy brown hair and a dark blue summer jacket, bends just far enough for the apple to reach his mouth. Lantern colors reflect off the glaze and bag water.
data.animaCaption: Eru in a violet furisode holds the goldfish bag and offers the candied apple. Short, tousle-haired Oreki in a dark blue summer jacket leans toward it from beside her.
